candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record documents both a myeloid neoplasm (FIP1L1-PDGFRA-positive CEL confirmed by bone marrow findings and RT-PCR) and a distinct cutaneous histiocytic proliferation (nodular CD68+/stabilin-1+/CD1a− dermal infiltrate consistent with GEH). The benchmark reference is a composite diagnosis requiring both entities. C001 correctly identifies the leukemia component but does not include GEH, leaving the composite incomplete.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures the CEL/FIP1L1-PDGFRA component but omits the associated generalized eruptive histiocytosis (GEH) component required by the composite benchmark reference

case_quality_flags: Composite diagnosis required: CEL with concurrent reactive/paraneoplastic GEH; single-entity candidates will be at most partial
